spanish: Control, los bocadillos vuelven a flotar.
english: Control, the snacks are floating again. | Control, snacks are floating again. | Control, the snacks escaped again.
Catch them. They come out of the budget. | Catch them. They're on the budget. | Grab them. Accounting is watching.
Control, how's the intern? | Control, how's the intern doing? | Control, any news about the intern?

spanish: Ha pintado el aparcamiento. A propósito, dice.
english: He painted the parking lot. On purpose, he says. | He painted the parking lot. He says on purpose. | He painted the parking lot. Deliberately, apparently.
Can we go home now? | Can we go home yet? | Control, home time?

spanish: Los científicos dicen que una órbita más.
english: The scientists say one more orbit. | Science wants one more orbit. | One more orbit, the scientists say.
They always say one more orbit. | It's always one more orbit. | They say that every time.
Is that bolt supposed to wiggle like that? | Should that bolt wiggle like that? | Control, is that bolt meant to wobble?
Define supposed. | Define should. | What do you mean, supposed?
If we go faster, do we get there sooner? | If we go faster, do we arrive sooner? | Faster means sooner, right?
Usually, yes. | Generally, yes. | In most cases.
Brilliant. | Genius. | Brilliant.

spanish: Control, ¿alguna vez nos miráis desde abajo?
english: Control, do you ever look up at us? | Control, do you ever look up at us? | Control, do you look up and see us?

spanish: Cada cinco minutos. Es nuestro trabajo.
english: Every five minutes. It's the job. | Every five minutes. Job requirement. | All the time. It's our job.

spanish: Veo el centro espacial desde aquí. Creo que saluda.
english: I can see the space center from here. I think it's waving. | I can see the space center. I think it's waving. | Control, I see the space center. Someone's waving.

spanish: Es el becario. Lleva así toda la mañana.
english: That's the intern. He's been at it all morning. | That's the intern. All morning. | The intern. He hasn't stopped.

spanish: Control, he encontrado un botón nuevo.
english: Control, I found a new button. | Control, there's a new button. | Control, I found a button I didn't know.
Don't press it. | Do not press it. | Leave it alone.
Too late. | Already did. | Oops. Pressed.
And what happened? | And? | What happened?
Nothing. How disappointing. | Nothing. Disappointing. | Nothing at all. Sad.

spanish: ¡Bien hecho, equipo! Aquí abajo aplauden todos.
english: Well done, team! Everyone down here is clapping. | Great job, team! Everyone here is clapping. | Well done, {vessel}! Applause down here.
Even the director? | The director too? | Is the director clapping?

spanish: Con una mano. Con la otra come.
english: With one hand. He's eating with the other. | One hand. The other has a sandwich. | With one hand. He's eating.
Control, how much does a rocket cost? | Control, what does a rocket cost? | Control, how expensive is this rocket?
Better not ask. | Don't ask. | You don't want to know.
More than a car? | More than a car? | Is it more than a car?
More than all the cars. | More than every car. | More than all cars combined.
Oops! Sorry, wrong button. Nothing, nothing. | Oops! Wrong button. Never mind. | Sorry! Wrong button. Ignore that.
Control, what was that? | Control, what was that? | What just happened, Control?
The bathroom lights. Carry on. | Bathroom lights. Continue. | Just the bathroom lights.
Control, it smells like socks up here. | Control, it smells like socks. | Control, there's a sock smell up here.

spanish: Eso no lo podemos arreglar desde abajo.
english: We can't fix that from down here. | Can't fix that from here. | We can't help with that.
Control, do you hear me well? | Control, can you hear me? | Control, am I coming through?

spanish: Alto y claro. Demasiado claro, a veces.
english: Loud and clear. Too clear, sometimes. | Loud and clear. Sometimes too clear. | Very clear. Too clear, at times.
Control, who won the match? | Control, who won the game? | Control, how did the match end?

spanish: Nadie. Se perdió el balón en el cráter.
english: Nobody. The ball got lost in the crater. | Nobody. The ball went into the crater. | No one. They lost the ball in the crater.

spanish: El director pregunta si estáis contentos.
english: The director asks if you're happy. | The director wants to know if you're happy. | Director asks: are you happy?

spanish: Dile que sí. Y que queremos más galletas.
english: Tell him yes. And that we want more cookies. | Yes. And we want more cookies. | Tell him yes. Plus cookies, please.
I'll tell him the first part. | I'll pass on the first part. | I'll mention the yes.
Control, I counted the stars. | Control, I counted the stars. | Control, star count is done.
And how many are there? | How many? | And?

spanish: Muchas. Perdí la cuenta en siete.
english: Lots. I lost count at seven. | Lots. I lost track at seven. | Many. I stopped at seven.
Has anyone seen my other glove? | Where's my other glove? | Control, have you seen my glove?

spanish: Sale en nuestra pantalla. Está flotando detrás de ti.
english: It's on our screen. It's floating behind you. | We see it on screen. It's behind you. | It's on camera. Right behind you.
Control, can we put on some music? | Control, can we have music? | Control, put on some music?

spanish: Solo si no es la del otro día.
english: Only if it's not the one from the other day. | Not the one from last time. | Fine, but not that song again.
It was very good. | It was great. | That was a good song.
It was an alarm. | It was the alarm. | That was the alarm.

spanish: Control, hemos hecho una apuesta aquí arriba.
english: Control, we made a bet up here. | Control, we have a bet going. | Control, we made a bet.
About what? | What about? | On what?

spanish: Sobre si contestaríais. Acabo de perder.
english: About whether you'd answer. I just lost. | If you'd answer. I lost. | Whether you'd reply. I lost.

spanish: Os recordamos que no se juega con la escotilla.
english: A reminder that the hatch is not a toy. | Reminder: the hatch is not a toy. | The hatch is not for playing, {vessel}.
spanish_rt: |  | La escotilla no es para jugar, {vessel}.

english: We were only looking at it. | We were just looking. | Only looking at it.
Lovingly, we saw that. | Very lovingly. We saw. | We saw. With love.

spanish: Control, aquí arriba no hay que fregar platos.
english: Control, there are no dishes to wash up here. | Control, no dishes to do up here. | Control, nobody does dishes in space.
That's why nobody wants to come back. | That's why nobody wants to come back. | Explains why no one comes home.

spanish: Control, ¿el café de abajo sigue igual de malo?
english: Control, is the coffee down there still that bad? | Control, still bad coffee down there? | Control, is the coffee still awful?

spanish: Peor. Alguien le ha echado sal.
english: Worse. Someone put salt in it. | Worse. Someone salted it. | Worse. There's salt in it now.
Ah, the intern. | The intern. | Ah. The intern.

spanish: Control, he hecho un dibujo de la nave.
english: Control, I made a drawing of the ship. | Control, I drew the ship. | Control, I made a picture of the ship.
Does it look like it? | Does it look right? | Is it a good likeness?

spanish: Tiene más alas. Y una cara.
english: It has more wings. And a face. | More wings. And a face. | It has a face. And extra wings.
Better than the real one. | Better than the real thing. | An improvement.

spanish: Mensaje de las familias: os quieren mucho.
english: Message from the families: they love you very much. | The families say they love you very much. | Message from home: lots of love.
We love them too! And the dog! | Love them too! And the dog! | Love you back! And the dog!
Control, when does the mail arrive? | Control, when is the mail coming? | Control, any mail for us?
Never. You're in space. | Never. Space. | It doesn't come to space.
Oh well. I was hoping for a letter. | Shame. I wanted a letter. | Oh well. Hoped for a letter.
Control, can you turn up the heating? | Control, more heating, please? | Control, can you make it warmer?
Put on another sweater. | Wear another sweater. | Put a sweater on.
You sound like my mother. | You sound like my mom. | That's what my mom says.

spanish: Tu madre está aquí al lado. Te saluda.
english: Your mother is right here. She says hi. | Your mom is here. She says hi. | She's standing next to me. Hi from mom.

spanish: Control, hemos visto una luz rara.
english: Control, we saw a strange light. | Control, we saw a weird light. | Control, strange light out there.
That was the sun. | The sun. | That's the sun.
Oh. It's so big. | Oh. It's huge. | Oh. Big, isn't it?

spanish: Aquí abajo hemos hecho una porra. ¿Cuántos días aguantáis sin quejaros?
english: We have a pool going down here. How many days can you go without complaining? | We have a pool: how many days without complaining? | Office bet: how long until you complain?
Who's winning? | Who's ahead? | Who's winning?
The one who said zero. | Whoever said zero. | The one who picked zero.

spanish: Control, este traje me hace gordo.
english: Control, this suit makes me look fat. | Control, this suit makes me look big. | Control, do I look fat in this suit?
It's the suit. Definitely. | Definitely the suit. | It's the suit. For sure.

spanish: Control, he puesto nombre a la nave.
english: Control, I gave the ship a name. | Control, the ship has a name now. | Control, I named the ship.
What is it? | And? | What's the name?
Mrs Pretty.

spanish: Lo apuntamos en el registro. Con miedo.
english: We'll put it in the log. With fear. | We'll log it. Nervously. | It goes in the log. With worry.
Control, mind if we take some photos? | Control, can we take photos? | Control, photo time?

spanish: Adelante. Y no salgáis con los ojos cerrados.
english: Go ahead. And keep your eyes open this time. | Sure. Eyes open this time. | Go ahead. Keep your eyes open.

spanish: ¿Alguien ha tocado la radio? Se oyen silbidos.
english: Has anyone touched the radio? We hear whistling. | Who's touching the radio? There's whistling. | We hear whistling. Who's on the radio?
That's me. I'm happy. | Me. I'm happy. | That's me. Good mood.
Whistle quieter, please. | Whistle softer, please. | Quieter whistling, please.

spanish: Control, aquí todo va tan bien que me aburro.
english: Control, it's going so well up here that I'm bored. | Control, it's going so well I'm bored. | Control, all fine. Boring, even.

spanish: Eso es lo que queremos. Aburrido es perfecto.
english: That's what we want. Boring is perfect. | Perfect. Boring is the goal. | Good. We want boring.
Control, I have a scientific question. | Control, science question. | Control, I have a question for science.
Go ahead. | Go on. | Ask away.
Do stars make a sound? | Do stars make noise? | Can stars make a sound?
We'll send you a book. | We'll mail you a book. | We'll send a book.
Control, what's this lever called? | Control, what's this lever's name? | Control, what's this lever called?

spanish: Esa no tiene nombre. No la toques.
english: That one has no name. Don't touch it. | No name. Don't touch. | It has no name. Hands off.
I'll call it Pepe. | It's Pepe now. | Then I'll call it Pepe.

spanish: Atención: el director ha perdido sus gafas. ¿Las tenéis vosotros?
english: Attention: the director lost his glasses. Do you have them? | The director lost his glasses. Do you have them? | Has anyone up there got the director's glasses?
How would we have them? | How could we? | Why would we have them?
You never know with you lot. | With you, who knows. | You never know with you.

spanish: Control, he aprendido a dormir boca abajo.
english: Control, I learned to sleep upside down. | Control, I can sleep upside down now. | Control, I learned to sleep upside down.

spanish: Aquí abajo eso se llama caerse de la cama.
english: Down here we call that falling out of bed. | Down here that's called falling out of bed. | We call that falling out of bed.
Control, can we stay one more day? | Control, one more day? | Control, can we stay another day?
Ask the fuel. | Ask the fuel. | That's up to the fuel.
It says maybe. | The fuel says maybe. | It says perhaps.

spanish: Control, he encontrado una galleta en mi bolsillo.
english: Control, I found a cookie in my pocket. | Control, there's a cookie in my pocket. | Control, I found a pocket cookie.
How old is it? | How old? | How old is it?
From training. | Training. | It's from training.
That was months ago. | Months ago. | That was months back.
It tastes like victory. | Tastes like winning. | It tastes like victory.

spanish: Buenas noticias: las encuestas dicen que sois los favoritos.
english: Good news: the polls say you're the favorites. | Good news: you're the favorites in the polls. | Polls say you're the favorites.
Favorites for what? | Favorites for what? | For what, exactly?

spanish: No lo sabemos. Pero sois los favoritos.
english: We don't know. But you're the favorites. | Unclear. But favorites. | No idea. Still, favorites.

spanish: Control, ¿seguro que esto es una nave y no una lata?
english: Control, are you sure this is a ship and not a can? | Control, is this a ship or a can? | Control, are you sure this isn't a tin can?
It's a very expensive can. | A very expensive can. | A really pricey can.
Control, who designed the seats? | Control, who made these seats? | Control, who designed the seats?
A committee. | A committee. | A big committee.
You can tell. | It shows. | I can tell.

spanish: Mandamos saludos de parte de la cafetería.
english: Greetings from the cafeteria. | Hello from the cafeteria. | The cafeteria says hi.
Did they make the cheesecake? | Is there cheesecake? | Did they make cheesecake?

spanish: Sí. Y nos la estamos comiendo. Lo siento.
english: Yes. And we're eating it. Sorry. | Yes. We're eating it. Sorry. | There is. We're having it. Sorry.

spanish: Control, si me quedo muy quieto, ¿cuento como satélite?
english: Control, if I stay very still, do I count as a satellite? | Control, if I keep still, am I a satellite? | Control, does staying still make me a satellite?
Technically, you already are. | Technically, you are one. | Technically, yes. Already.
I knew it! | I knew it! | Yes!

spanish: Control, he mirado por la ventana diez veces.
english: Control, I looked out the window ten times. | Control, I checked the window ten times. | Control, ten looks out the window.
And? | And? | Result?
It's still there. All of it. | Still there. All of it. | It's all still there.
Reminder: medical check tomorrow. | Reminder: medical check tomorrow. | Tomorrow is the medical check.
The tongue one again? | The tongue one? | Again with the tongue?
The tongue one. | The tongue one. | Yes. Tongue.

spanish: Control, el piloto canta en la ducha.
english: Control, the pilot sings in the shower. | Control, the pilot sings in the shower. | Control, our pilot does shower singing.
There is no shower up there. | You have no shower. | There's no shower up there.
He sings anyway. | He sings anyway. | Still sings.
Control, can you repeat the last message? | Control, repeat the last message? | Control, say again the last message?
It was: nothing to repeat. | It was: nothing to repeat. | Nothing to repeat. That was it.
Copy. Thanks. | Copy. Thanks. | Got it. Thanks.

spanish: Control, hoy me siento con suerte.
english: Control, I feel lucky today. | Control, I feel lucky. | Control, today is my lucky day.

spanish: No toques nada con esa suerte.
english: Don't touch anything with that luck. | Use that luck on nothing, please. | Don't touch anything with that luck.
I love this job. | Best job ever. | I really love this job.

spanish: Si mi madre me viera ahora.
english: If my mother could see me now. | If only my mom could see this. | Mom would love this view.

spanish: Creo que me he dejado el horno encendido.
english: I think I left the oven on. | Did I leave the oven on? | I might have left the oven on.
I'm better at floating today. | My floating is better today. | I float much better today.

spanish: Mis calcetines se han ido a explorar.
english: My socks went off exploring. | My socks have gone on an adventure. | My socks wandered off again.

spanish: Todo en orden. Y la vista, preciosa.
english: All in order. And the view is lovely. | All fine. Lovely view, too. | Everything in order. Nice view.

spanish: He saludado a una estrella. No ha contestado.
english: I waved at a star. It didn't wave back. | I waved at a star. No wave back. | A star ignored my wave.

spanish: Aquí arriba el silencio es enorme.
english: The silence up here is huge. | It's so quiet up here. | The silence here is enormous.
I'm hungry again. | Hungry again. | I'm already hungry again.

spanish: Esto es mejor que las montañas rusas.
english: This beats roller coasters. | Better than a roller coaster. | Roller coasters can't compete.

spanish: Las luces del panel parecen un árbol de fiesta.
english: The panel lights look like a party tree. | The panel looks like a party tree. | All these lights. Like a party.

spanish: He perdido el lápiz. Otra vez.
english: I lost the pencil. Again. | Lost the pencil again. | Where did the pencil go? Again.

spanish: Si alguien pregunta, yo no he tocado nada.
english: If anyone asks, I didn't touch anything. | If anyone asks, I touched nothing. | For the record, I didn't touch anything.

spanish: Creo que ya sé para qué sirve este botón.
english: I think I know what this button does now. | I think I figured out this button. | Now I know what this button does. I think.

spanish: El sándwich de hoy tiene forma de planeta.
english: Today's sandwich is shaped like a planet. | My sandwich today looks like a planet. | Planet-shaped sandwich today.

spanish: Estoy haciendo ejercicio. Más o menos.
english: I'm exercising. Sort of. | Doing exercise. Kind of. | I'm working out. Sort of.

spanish: Me he peinado para la cámara.
english: I combed my hair for the camera. | I combed my hair for the camera. | Hair combed. Camera ready.
Everything looks tiny from here. | It all looks so tiny from here. | Everything is tiny from up here.

spanish: Aquí todo bien. Bueno, casi todo. El café no.
english: All good up here. Well, almost all. Not the coffee. | All good. Except the coffee. | Everything's fine. Well, not the coffee.

spanish: Escribo en mi diario: hoy, todo en verde.
english: Writing in my diary: today, all green. | Diary entry: all green today. | Dear diary: everything green.
I wish I could send a postcard. | I wish I could mail a postcard. | Wish I could send a postcard from {here}.
spanish_rt: |  | Ojalá pudiera mandar una postal desde {here}.

spanish: Esto es lo más bonito que he visto. Después de las galletas.
english: This is the prettiest thing I've seen. After cookies. | Prettiest thing I've seen. After cookies. | Most beautiful thing ever. Cookies excluded.

spanish: Me he dado cuenta de que no sé silbar sin gravedad.
english: I just found out I can't whistle without gravity. | Turns out I can't whistle without gravity. | No gravity, no whistling. Who knew.
Still here. Still handsome. | Still here. Still good-looking. | Still here. Still looking good.

spanish: Hoy voy a batir un récord. Aún no sé de qué.
english: I'm breaking a record today. Not sure what yet. | I'm setting a record today. Don't know which. | Record day today. Some record.
Everyone down here is smiling. | Everybody down here is smiling. | Big smiles at Control.

spanish: Recibido. Lo apuntamos en la pizarra.
english: Copy. We put it on the whiteboard. | Copy. It's on the whiteboard. | Copied. Whiteboard material.
Keep it up, you're doing great. | Keep going. You're doing great. | Great work, {vessel}. Keep it up.
The intern says hi. | The intern says hello. | Hi from the intern.
Copied. We love hearing from you. | Copy. Always nice to hear you. | Copied. We love your calls.
Copy. We're so jealous. | Copy. Very jealous. | Copied. We're so envious.
All green down here too. | Green down here as well. | All green on our side too.

spanish: El director ha hecho un pulgar arriba.
english: The director gave a thumbs up. | Thumbs up from the director. | The director says thumbs up.
Sending you a huge hug. | A big hug from all of us. | Huge hug coming your way.

spanish: Copiado. Eso va al álbum de recuerdos.
english: Copied. That's going in the scrapbook. | Copy. That's going in the scrapbook. | Scrapbook-worthy. Copied.
Someone down here just clapped. | Someone here just clapped. | We heard clapping down here.

spanish: Entendido. No toquéis nada que brille.
english: Understood. Don't touch anything shiny. | Copy. Nothing shiny, please. | Understood. Leave the shiny things alone.

spanish: Sois nuestros favoritos. No se lo digáis a los otros.
english: You're our favorites. Don't tell the others. | You're our favorites. Shh. | Don't tell the others: you're our favorites.

spanish: Copiado. Lo hemos oído todos. Todos.
english: Copied. We all heard that. All of us. | Copied. Everyone heard that. Everyone. | We all heard that. All of us.
Copy. Very professional. Almost. | Copy. Nearly professional. | Very professional. Mostly.

spanish: Hemos subido el volumen para oíros mejor.
english: We turned up the volume to hear you better. | We turned you up. Louder now. | Volume up. We hear you better.

spanish: Seguid con la fiesta. Con cuidado.
english: Carry on with the party. Carefully. | Keep partying. Carefully. | Enjoy the party. Gently.

spanish: Os seguimos en la pantalla grande.
english: You're on the big screen down here. | You're on the big screen here. | Big screen down here. That's you.

spanish: Copiado. Eso ha sonado muy heroico.
english: Copied. That sounded very heroic. | Copied. Very heroic. | That sounded heroic. Copied.

spanish: La cafetería os dedica una canción.
english: The cafeteria dedicates a song to you. | The cafeteria is playing a song for you. | A song from the cafeteria, just for you.

spanish: Si necesitáis algo, estamos aquí. Comiendo.
english: If you need anything, we're here. Eating. | Need anything? We're here. Eating. | We're here if you need us. Snacking.

spanish: ¡Hola, nave! Solo llamábamos para decir hola.
english: Hello, ship! Just calling to say hello. | Hello, {vessel}! Just saying hi. | Hi, ship! Just a hello call.

spanish: Aquí Control. Os echamos de menos. Un poco.
english: Control here. We miss you. A little. | Control here. We miss you. Slightly. | This is Control. We miss you a bit.

spanish: Control a nave. Las plantas del despacho siguen vivas.
english: Control to ship. The office plants are still alive. | The office plants are still alive. | Update: office plants still alive.

spanish: Informe del tiempo: soleado aquí, espacio ahí.
english: Weather report: sunny here, space up there. | Weather: sunny down here, space up there. | Forecast: sun here, space for you.

spanish: Atención, nave: hoy es martes. Por si acaso.
english: Attention, ship: today is Tuesday. Just in case. | Ship, it's Tuesday. In case you wondered. | Fun fact: today is Tuesday.

spanish: Novedades del centro: alguien ha roto la fotocopiadora. Otra vez.
english: News from the center: someone broke the copier. Again. | Center news: the copier broke again. | Someone broke the copier. Again.

spanish: Aquí abajo hemos puesto vuestra foto en la pared.
english: We put your photo on the wall down here. | Your photo is on our wall. | We hung your picture on the wall.

spanish: Seguimos aquí, por si os sentís solos.
english: We're still here, in case you feel lonely. | Still here, if you feel lonely. | We're still here, {vessel}.

spanish: El becario ha preguntado si podéis traer una piedra.
english: The intern asked if you can bring back a rock. | The intern wants a rock. | Can you bring the intern a rock?

spanish: Control, el asiento está un poco frío.
english: Control, the seat is a bit cold. | Control, the seat is cold. | Control, chilly seat here.
It'll warm up soon. Very soon. | It'll warm up soon. Very soon. | Soon it will be warm. Very warm.
Control, how long now? | Control, how long? | Control, how much longer?

spanish: Poco. No te vayas al baño.
english: Not long. Don't go to the bathroom. | Not long. No bathroom trips. | Soon. Don't go to the bathroom now.
Control, has anyone checked the bolts? | Control, did anyone check the bolts? | Control, bolts checked?

spanish: Todos. Dos veces. El becario, tres.
english: All of them. Twice. The intern, three times. | All, twice. The intern did three times. | Every bolt. Twice. Three times by the intern.
That worries me more. | That worries me more. | Now I'm more worried.
Control, can I change seats? | Control, can I switch seats? | Control, can we swap seats?

spanish: No. Todos los asientos son iguales.
english: No. All the seats are the same. | No. They're all the same. | All seats are identical.

spanish: El de la ventana parece mejor.
english: The window one looks better. | The window seat looks nicer. | I want the window seat.

spanish: Equipo, último aviso: ¿alguien necesita ir al baño?
english: Team, last call: does anyone need the bathroom? | Last call: anyone need the bathroom? | Final bathroom call, team.
Now that you mention it... | Well, now that you ask... | Actually...
Too late. | Too late. | Sorry. Too late.

spanish: Control, aquí huele a pintura fresca.
english: Control, it smells like fresh paint in here. | Control, I smell fresh paint. | Control, it smells like paint in here.

spanish: Es pintura fresca. La pusimos esta mañana.
english: It is fresh paint. We put it on this morning. | Fresh paint. From this morning. | It is paint. We painted it this morning.

spanish: Control, he hecho una lista de lo que quiero ver.
english: Control, I made a list of what I want to see. | Control, I have a list of things to see. | Control, I wrote a sightseeing list.
What's on the list? | What's on it? | Read it to us.
Everything. | Everything. | All of it.

spanish: El público está contando con vosotros. Literalmente. Ya cuentan hacia atrás.
english: The crowd is counting on you. Literally. They're already counting down. | The crowd is counting on you. They're counting down already. | The crowd is counting. Down, mostly.
Hello, crowd! | Hi, crowd! | Hello, everybody!
Control, does the rocket have reverse? | Control, is there a reverse gear? | Control, can this rocket go backwards?
No. | No. | Negative.
Okay. Just asking. | Okay. Just checking. | Fine. Only asking.
I'm ready. I think. Pretty sure. | Ready. I think. Fairly sure. | I'm ready. Probably. Mostly.

spanish: Dicen que el primer viaje no se olvida.
english: They say you never forget your first trip. | You never forget your first flight, they say. | They say the first trip stays with you.

spanish: Me he atado el cinturón dos veces. Por si acaso.
english: I buckled up twice. Just in case. | Buckled up twice. To be safe. | Double buckled. Just in case.

spanish: Los ingenieros os desean suerte. Mucha suerte.
english: The engineers wish you luck. Lots of luck. | The engineers wish you luck. A lot of it. | Good luck from engineering. Lots of it.

spanish: La prensa pregunta si estáis nerviosos. Les hemos dicho que no.
english: The press asks if you're nervous. We told them no. | The press asked if you're nervous. We said no. | Reporters asked about nerves. We said none.
Control, we go round and round. | Control, we keep going around. | Control, we're going in circles.
That's the idea. | That's the point. | That's how orbits work.

spanish: Ah. Pensaba que nos habíamos perdido.
english: Oh. I thought we were lost. | Oh. I thought we were lost. | Oh good. I thought we were lost.

spanish: Control, he visto el amanecer cuatro veces hoy.
english: Control, I saw the sunrise four times today. | Control, four sunrises today. | Control, I've seen four sunrises today.
Show-off. | Bragging. | Show-off.

spanish: Control, ¿desde aquí se ve mi casa?
english: Control, can you see my house from here? | Control, can I see my house? | Control, is my house visible from up here?
If you squint, yes. | If you squint. | Squint a bit. Yes.
I see it! I think. | There it is! Maybe. | I see it! I think.

spanish: Control, aquí arriba no hay arriba.
english: Control, there's no up up here. | Control, there's no up here. | Control, which way is up?

spanish: Ni abajo. Por eso os mareáis.
english: Or down. That's why you get dizzy. | Or down. Hence the dizziness. | No down either. That's the dizziness.

spanish: Control, hemos dejado de caer. ¿O seguimos?
english: Control, did we stop falling? Or are we still? | Control, are we still falling? | Control, did the falling stop?
Still falling. Sideways. | Still falling. Sideways. | Yes. Sideways falling.
How elegant. | Very elegant. | How graceful.

spanish: Os vemos pasar por encima. Os estamos saludando.
english: We see you pass overhead. We're waving. | We can see you pass over us. We're waving. | You're passing overhead. We're waving.
We saw you! Well, no! But hello! | We saw you! Well, no. But hi! | Hi! We didn't see you. But hi!

spanish: La órbita es como un columpio que no para.
english: Orbit is like a swing that never stops. | An orbit is a swing that never stops. | Orbiting is like an endless swing.

spanish: Una vuelta más y me sé el camino de memoria.
english: One more lap and I'll know the way by heart. | One more lap and I'll know it by heart. | Another lap and I know the route.

spanish: Órbita estable. Ahora sí podéis comer.
english: Stable orbit. Now you may eat. | Stable orbit. You may eat now. | Orbit is stable. Lunch time.
Control, how much longer is the trip? | Control, how long is the trip still? | Control, how far to go?
Quite a while. Did you bring games? | A good while. Did you pack games? | Quite long. Any games up there?
A deck of cards. Some are missing. | Cards. Not all of them. | One deck. A few cards missing.

spanish: Control, aquí no pasa nada de nada.
english: Control, nothing at all is happening here. | Control, absolutely nothing is happening. | Control, nothing going on. At all.

spanish: Mejor así. Sin noticias, buenas noticias.
english: Better that way. No news is good news. | Good. No news is good news. | That's how we like it.

spanish: Control, he leído el manual entero.
english: Control, I read the whole manual. | Control, I finished the manual. | Control, I read the entire manual.
And? | And? | Verdict?
The ending is very sad. | Very sad ending. | The ending made me cry.
Control, can we stop for a drink? | Control, can we stop for a drink? | Control, any place to grab a drink?

spanish: No hay bares en el espacio.
english: There are no bars in space. | Space has no bars. | No bars out there.
Yet. | Not yet. | For now.

spanish: Informe del viaje: vais muy bien. Y muy lejos.
english: Trip report: you're doing very well. And very far. | Trip report: you're doing well. And far. | Travel update: doing great. Very far away.
Very, very far? | Very, very far? | How far is very far?
Very, very far. | Very, very far. | Extremely far.

spanish: El espacio es grande. Mucho más grande que en los dibujos.
english: Space is big. Much bigger than in the drawings. | Space is huge. Way bigger than the pictures. | Space is much bigger than in the drawings.

spanish: He empezado a contar los días. Ya voy por muchos.
english: I started counting the days. I'm at lots. | I'm counting the days. I'm at many. | Day count: lots. Day {day}, maybe.
spanish_rt: |  | Días contados: muchos. El día {day}, creo.

spanish: Seguimos con vosotros. Aunque tardéis en contestar.
english: We're still with you. Even if you're slow to answer. | Still with you. Even when you answer slowly. | We're here. Even if you take ages to answer.
Control, we made it! Now what? | Control, we did it! What now? | Control, we're down! Now what?

spanish: Ahora disfrutad. Y no os comáis las piedras.
english: Now enjoy it. And don't eat the rocks. | Enjoy. And don't eat rocks. | Enjoy {here}. No eating the rocks.
spanish_rt: |  | Disfrutad de {here}. Y no os comáis las piedras.

spanish: Control, el suelo es muy suelo.
english: Control, the ground is very ground. | Control, the ground is very groundy. | Control, this ground is extremely ground.
Great scientific observation. | Fantastic science. | Excellent scientific observation.

spanish: Control, he dejado una huella preciosa.
english: Control, I left a beautiful footprint. | Control, I made a beautiful footprint. | Control, perfect footprint on {here}.

spanish: Hazle una foto. Para el museo.
english: Take a photo. For the museum. | Photo, please. For the museum. | Take a picture. Museum piece.
Control, there's nobody here. | Control, nobody is here. | [away] Control, {here} is empty.
Now there's you. | There's you now. | Now you're here.
That's nice. | Nice. | That's sweet.
Control, can we live here? | Control, can we move here? | [away] Control, could we live on {here}?
Fill in the form first. | Paperwork first. | Fill in the form.

spanish: Bienvenidos al suelo. Por favor, no pisoteéis la ciencia.
english: Welcome to the ground. Please don't trample the science. | Welcome to the ground. Don't step on the science. | Welcome to {here}. Mind the science.
spanish_rt: |  | Bienvenidos a {here}. Cuidado con la ciencia.

english: It's so nice to stand still. | Standing still is so nice. | Finally, not moving.

spanish: Ya he recogido tres piedras. Una se parece a ti, Control.
english: I picked up three rocks. One looks like you, Control. | I took three rocks. One looks like you, Control. | Three rocks collected. One has your face, Control.

spanish: Control, ¿puedo hacer una voltereta? Una pequeñita.
english: Control, can I do a flip? A tiny one. | Control, can I do a flip? Small one. | Control, a tiny flip?
No. | No. | Negative.
Half of one? | Half a flip? | Just half?
Not that either. | No to that too. | Not half either.

spanish: Control, esta nave vuela sola. Casi me ofende.
english: Control, this ship flies itself. I'm almost offended. | Control, the ship flies itself. I'm a bit offended. | Control, I'm not even needed. Rude.

spanish: Pues déjala. Así no tocas nada.
english: Then let it. That way you touch nothing. | Let it. Then you won't touch anything. | Good. Then hands off.

spanish: Control, ¿me dais nota de ese último giro?
english: Control, can you score that last turn? | Control, score that last turn? | Control, how was that turn?
A seven. For style. | Seven. For style. | A seven, for style.
Only a seven? | Just seven? | Only a seven?

spanish: He aparcado esta nave mejor que mi coche.
english: I parked this ship better than my car. | I parked this better than my car. | Better parking than my car at home.
Control, I fixed a thing. | Control, I fixed something. | Control, I repaired a thing.
Was it broken? | Was it broken? | Was it broken before?
Not anymore. | It isn't now. | Not anymore.

spanish: Eso no responde a la pregunta.
english: That doesn't answer the question. | Not an answer. | That's not what I asked.
Control, I have two bolts left over. | Control, two bolts left over. | Control, I have spare bolts. Two.
From where? | Left over from what? | From where?
That's the big question. | Exactly the question. | Good question.

spanish: Control, he mejorado la cafetera con cinta.
english: Control, I upgraded the coffee machine with tape. | Control, I upgraded the coffee machine. With tape. | Control, coffee machine fixed. Tape.
Does it work? | Working? | Does it work?
It makes coffee. And a noise. | It makes coffee. And noise. | Coffee, plus a strange noise.

spanish: Si algo se rompe, tengo cinta. Mucha cinta.
english: If something breaks, I have tape. Lots of tape. | If anything breaks, I have tape. So much tape. | Don't worry. I brought lots of tape.
Control, I have a new theory. | Control, new theory. | Control, I have a theory.
About what? | About? | About what?

spanish: Sobre por qué las galletas flotan mejor que el pan.
english: About why cookies float better than bread. | Why cookies float better than bread. | Cookies float better than bread. Why?

spanish: Mándanos los datos. Y una galleta.
english: Send us the data. And a cookie. | Send data. And a cookie. | Send us the data. Plus a cookie.

spanish: Control, he medido el silencio. Es muy silencioso.
english: Control, I measured the silence. It's very silent. | Control, I measured the silence. Very silent. | Control, silence report: extremely quiet.
We'll note that. Big discovery. | Noted. Huge discovery. | Big discovery. We'll write it down.
Control, I filled another notebook. | Control, another notebook full. | Control, filled one more notebook.
With data? | Data? | With data?

spanish: De datos. Y de dibujos de nubes.
english: With data. And drawings of clouds. | Data. And cloud drawings. | Data. Also clouds. Drawn.

spanish: Todo es ciencia si lo miras de cerca.
english: Everything is science if you look closely. | Look closely and everything is science. | It's all science, if you look.
Control, does this include breakfast? | Control, is breakfast included? | Control, does this trip include breakfast?
There are pouches. | Pouches. | There are pouches.
I'll leave a review. | I'm writing a review. | One star. Review coming.

spanish: Control, ¿dónde está la tienda de recuerdos?
english: Control, where's the gift shop? | Control, where's the gift shop? | Control, any souvenir shop?
Down here. When you get back. | Down here. After you land. | At home. When you're back.

spanish: Control, he hecho cien fotos. Todas de mi cara.
english: Control, I took a hundred photos. All of my face. | Control, a hundred photos. All my face. | Control, I took a hundred selfies.

spanish: Haz una de la ventana. Por variar.
english: Take one of the window. For a change. | Try the window. For once. | Photograph the window. For a change.

spanish: Es el mejor viaje de mi vida. Bueno, el único.
english: Best trip of my life. Well, the only one. | Best trip ever. Also my only one. | Greatest trip of my life. The only one.
Control, is the Mun made of cheese? | Control, is the Mun cheese? | Control, is the Mun really made of cheese?
No. | No. | Negative.
Sure? It smells funny. | You sure? Smells odd. | Positive? Something smells.
That's the ship. | That's the ship. | That smell is the ship.

spanish: Control, he encontrado el botón de pausa.
english: Control, I found the pause button. | Control, I found pause. | Control, there's a pause button.
There is no pause button. | There's no pause. | No such button exists.
Then what did I press? | So what did I press? | Then what did I just press?

spanish: Control, ¿por qué el sol no se apaga por la noche?
english: Control, why doesn't the sun turn off at night? | Control, why doesn't the sun switch off at night? | Control, when does the sun go off?

spanish: Te lo explicamos cuando vuelvas. Con dibujos.
english: We'll explain when you're back. With pictures. | We'll explain later. With pictures. | Later. We'll bring diagrams.

spanish: Control, esto está demasiado tranquilo. Me gusta el riesgo.
english: Control, this is too quiet. I like danger. | Control, too quiet. I want danger. | Control, I like danger. This is boring.

spanish: Aquí no. Aquí nos gusta tranquilo.
english: Not here. Here we like quiet. | Not here. We like quiet. | No danger. Quiet is good.

spanish: Control, sin problemas. Nunca hay problemas.
english: Control, no problems. There are never problems. | Control, no problems. Never any problems. | Control, everything's fine. Always.
You always say that. | You say that every time. | You always say that.
And I'm always right. | And I'm always right. | Always right, too.
Control, is that noise normal? | Control, is that noise normal? | Control, what's that noise?
What noise? | Which noise? | What noise?
Mine. I'm shaking. | Me. I'm shaking. | It's me. Shaking.
Breathe. Everything's fine. | Breathe. It's fine. | Deep breath. All good.

spanish: Control, ¿podéis decirme otra vez que todo va bien?
english: Control, can you tell me again that everything's fine? | Control, say again that everything's fine? | Control, tell me it's fine again?
Everything's fine. | Everything is fine. | It's all fine.

spanish: Gracias. Otra vez dentro de un minuto.
english: Thanks. Again in a minute, please. | Thanks. Again in a minute. | Thanks. Repeat in a minute, please.

spanish: Control, en mis tiempos los cohetes eran de madera.
english: Control, in my day rockets were made of wood. | Control, back in my day rockets were wooden. | Control, we used wooden rockets in my day.
That's not true. | Not true. | That's false.
Well, cardboard. | Fine. Cardboard. | Cardboard, then.

spanish: Control, he visto muchas vistas. Esta sigue siendo la mejor.
english: Control, I've seen a lot of views. This one is still the best. | Control, of all the views, this is still the best. | Control, I've seen many views. Still the best.

spanish: Nos alegra oír eso de ti.
english: We're glad to hear that from you. | Happy to hear it. | Glad you think so.

spanish: Nave, ¿alguien ha cogido el bolígrafo del director?
english: Ship, did someone take the director's pen? | Did someone take the director's pen? | Ship, the director's pen is missing.
It's here. It floats very well. | Here. It floats great. | We have it. Excellent floater.
He wants it back. | He wants it back. | He'd like it back.
He can come and get it. | He can come get it. | Come pick it up.
Control, can you put me through to the cafeteria? | Control, connect me to the cafeteria? | Control, can you patch me to the cafeteria?
This isn't a switchboard. | We're not a switchboard. | This isn't a phone line.
I wanted to order a pizza. | I wanted pizza. | I was ordering pizza.
Team, we're sending you a joke. Ready? | Joke incoming. Ready? | Team, we have a joke for you. Ready?
Ready! | Ready! | Go!

spanish: ¿Qué hace un cohete en el sofá?
english: What does a rocket do on the sofa? | What does a rocket do on the couch? | Rocket on a sofa. What does it do?
What? | What? | Tell us.
Takes off for a nap. Sorry. | It takes off. For a nap. Sorry. | Takes off for a nap. I apologize.

spanish: Control, he intentado beber agua y me ha atacado.
english: Control, I tried to drink water and it attacked me. | Control, the water attacked me. | Control, I tried drinking. The water fought back.

spanish: Las burbujas de agua son traicioneras.
english: Water bubbles are treacherous. | Water bubbles are sneaky. | Never trust a water bubble.

spanish: Control, ¿los planetas tienen nombre o se lo ponemos nosotros?
english: Control, do planets have names or do we name them? | Control, do planets have names already? | Control, can we name the planets?
They already have names. | They have names. | Already named.
Shame. I had a great one. | Pity. I had a good one. | Shame. Mine was great.

spanish: Os informamos de que el becario ha ascendido.
english: We're informing you that the intern got promoted. | News: the intern was promoted. | The intern got a promotion.
To what? | To what? | Promoted to what?
Head intern. | Chief intern. | Head intern.

spanish: Control, ¿cuántos botones hay en este panel?
english: Control, how many buttons are on this panel? | Control, how many buttons on this panel? | Control, button count on this panel?
Forty-two. | Forty-two. | There are forty-two.
I count forty-three. | I see forty-three. | I count forty-three.
Don't press that one. | Don't press that one. | Leave that one alone.

spanish: Control, he soñado que me quedaba sin galletas.
english: Control, I dreamt I ran out of cookies. | Control, I dreamt we had no cookies. | Control, nightmare: no cookies left.
It was a dream. There are plenty left. | Just a dream. There are lots. | Only a dream. Plenty left.
How many? | How many? | Exactly how many?

spanish: No te lo vamos a decir.
english: We're not telling you. | Not telling. | Classified.
Control, who decides the menu? | Control, who picks the menu? | Control, who decides what we eat?
A computer. | A computer. | The computer does.
I thought so. | Figures. | I suspected.

spanish: Nave, ¿podéis repetir eso más despacio? El becario toma notas.
english: Ship, can you repeat that slower? The intern is taking notes. | Repeat slower? The intern is writing it down. | Slower, please. The intern takes notes.
Everything. Is. Fine. | Everything. Is. Fine. | All. Is. Good.
Thanks. He spelled it wrong. | Thanks. He misspelled it. | Got it. Spelled wrong, but got it.
Control, are you doing anything fun down there? | Control, anything fun down there? | Control, what do you do for fun?
We watch screens. | We watch screens. | Screens. We watch them.
And what's on the screens? | What's on them? | Showing what?

spanish: Vosotros. Sois lo mejor de la tele.
english: You. You're the best thing on TV. | You. Best show on TV. | You. Top rated.
Control, how many people are listening to us? | Control, how many people are listening? | Control, who's listening right now?
Right now, everyone. | Everyone, right now. | Everybody.

spanish: Hola a todos. Me peiné para esto.
english: Hello everyone. I combed my hair for this. | Hi, everyone. I combed my hair. | Hello, all. Hair combed for this.

spanish: Control, alguien ha dibujado una cara en la ventana.
english: Control, someone drew a face on the window. | Control, someone drew a face on the window. | Control, there's a face on the window.
Is it smiling? | Smiling? | Is it smiling?
Yes. | Yes. | It is.
Then leave it. | Leave it, then. | Keep it.

spanish: El jefe de vuelo quiere saber quién se comió su yogur antes del lanzamiento.
english: The flight director wants to know who ate his yogurt before launch. | Who ate the flight director's yogurt before launch? | The director asks about his yogurt. The pre-launch one.

spanish: No sé de qué me habla.
english: I don't know what he's talking about. | No idea what he means. | I know nothing about yogurt.
You have yogurt in your mustache. | There's yogurt in your mustache. | Your mustache says otherwise.

spanish: Control, ¿podéis apagar el sol un rato? Quiero dormir.
english: Control, can you switch off the sun for a bit? I want to sleep. | Control, turn off the sun? I need sleep. | Control, can the sun go off? Sleep time.

spanish: Lo intentamos. No nos hace caso.
english: We tried. It doesn't listen. | We tried. It ignores us. | Tried. It won't listen.

spanish: Control, he hablado con una planta del laboratorio.
english: Control, I talked to a plant in the lab. | Control, I talked to a plant. | Control, I chatted with a plant in the lab.
And what did it say? | What did it say? | And?
Nothing. But it listened. | Nothing. But it listened. | Not much. Good listener, though.

spanish: Pregunta del público: ¿dónde guardáis los calcetines?
english: Question from the public: where do you keep your socks? | Public question: where are your socks? | A viewer asks: where do you keep socks?
Everywhere. | Everywhere. | All over the place.
Perfect answer. | Great answer. | Perfect.
Control, how long until snack time? | Control, when's snack time? | Control, how long till snacks?
You just ate. | You just ate. | You ate a minute ago.

spanish: Eso no responde a la pregunta.
english: That doesn't answer the question. | That's not an answer. | Not what I asked.
Control, I wrote a poem. | Control, I wrote a poem. | Control, poem time.
Go ahead. | Let's hear it. | Go ahead.

spanish: Espacio, espacio, qué grande eres. Fin.
english: Space, space, how big you are. The end. | Space, space, you are so big. The end. | Oh space, so big. The end.
Beautiful. Short. Beautiful. | Lovely. Short. Lovely. | Beautiful. And short.

spanish: Control, ¿podéis mandarme la receta de la sopa?
english: Control, can you send me the soup recipe? | Control, send me the soup recipe? | Control, what's in the soup?
It's salty water. | Salt water. | Salty water.
Well, it's delicious. | Delicious, though. | Still tasty.

spanish: Atención, nave: la cafetería ha cambiado de horario.
english: Attention, ship: the cafeteria changed its hours. | The cafeteria has new opening hours. | News: new cafeteria hours.
That doesn't affect us. | Doesn't affect us. | We're in space.

spanish: Lo sabemos. Queríamos compartir el dolor.
english: We know. We wanted to share the pain. | We know. Sharing the pain. | We just wanted company in our pain.

spanish: Control, he flotado hasta el techo. ¿Cómo bajo?
english: Control, I floated to the ceiling. How do I get down? | Control, I'm on the ceiling. How do I get down? | Control, stuck on the ceiling.

spanish: No hay techo. Todo es suelo.
english: There is no ceiling. Everything is floor. | No ceiling. It's all floor. | There's no ceiling. All floor.
How philosophical. | Deep. | Very philosophical.
Control, do we have permission to sing? | Control, permission to sing? | Control, may we sing?
Permission granted. Low volume. | Granted. Quietly. | Granted. Low volume.
La la la! | La la la! | La la la la!
Lower. | Quieter. | Lower, please.

spanish: Control, he puesto mi foto en la pared de la nave.
english: Control, I put my photo on the ship's wall. | Control, I hung my photo in the ship. | Control, my picture is on the wall now.
Why? | Why? | What for?
So I don't miss myself. | So I don't miss myself. | In case I miss me.

spanish: Nave, el director dice que sois un ejemplo para todos.
english: Ship, the director says you're an example for everyone. | The director says you're an example to all. | Director says: you're an example.
A good example? | Good example? | A good one?
An example. | An example. | Just an example.
Control, are there birthdays in space? | Control, do we have birthdays in space? | Control, birthdays up here?
Of course. Whose is it? | Sure. Whose? | Of course. Whose is it?
Nobody's. But I wanted cake. | Nobody's. I just want cake. | No one's. I wanted cake.

spanish: Control, este viaje necesita más ventanas.
english: Control, this trip needs more windows. | Control, more windows needed. | Control, this ship needs more windows.
We'll tell the designers. | We'll pass it on. | We'll tell design.
And a sofa. | Also a sofa. | And a couch.
Not that. | No. | Not that.
Control, if I sneeze, do we change course? | Control, does a sneeze change our course? | Control, if I sneeze, do we drift?
A tiny bit. Don't do it. | Slightly. Don't. | A bit. Please don't.
Too late. Achoo! | Too late. Achoo! | Achoo! Sorry.
Correcting course. | Correcting. | Course correction.

spanish: El becario ha preguntado si el espacio huele a algo.
english: The intern asked if space smells like anything. | The intern asks what space smells like. | Does space smell? The intern wants to know.
Like metal. And socks. | Metal. And socks. | Like metal and socks.

spanish: Le diremos solo lo del metal.
english: We'll only tell him the metal part. | We'll just tell him metal. | We'll keep the socks part secret.

spanish: Control, he aprendido a dar volteretas sin manos.
english: Control, I learned to do flips with no hands. | Control, no-hands flips now. | Control, I can flip without hands.

spanish: Muy bien. Ahora aprende a parar.
english: Very good. Now learn to stop. | Great. Now learn to stop. | Nice. Next lesson: stopping.
Control, can you tell me a story? | Control, tell me a story? | Control, story time?

spanish: Érase una vez un kerbal que no tocaba nada.
english: Once upon a time there was a kerbal who touched nothing. | Once there was a kerbal who touched nothing. | Once upon a time, a kerbal touched nothing.
And what happened? | Then what? | And?
Nothing. He was happy. The end. | Nothing. Happy. The end. | He was happy. The end.
Woohoo! I mean... copy. Very good. | Yay! Sorry. Copy. Good. | Woohoo! Ahem. Copy.
So pretty! Sorry. Data looks correct. | Gorgeous! Sorry. The data checks out. | Pretty! Ahem. Data is correct.

spanish: Aquí Control. Esperad, que se me ha caído el bocadillo.
english: Control here. Hold on, I dropped my sandwich. | Control here. Wait, sandwich fell. | One moment. Dropped my sandwich.

spanish: ¡Lo sabía! Sabía que funcionaría. Más o menos.
english: I knew it! I knew it would work. More or less. | I knew it! I knew it'd work. Mostly. | Ha! It worked. More or less.

spanish: Toda la sala está aplaudiendo. Uno llora un poco.
english: The whole room is clapping. One of them is crying a bit. | The room is applauding. Someone is crying a little. | Applause down here. One person is crying.

spanish: Os mando un saludo. No, espera, ese era el botón del café.
english: Sending you a greeting. No, wait, that was the coffee button. | Greetings from us. Wait, that was the coffee button. | Sending a hello. No, that was coffee.

spanish: Control a nave. ¡Ay, perdón, me he sentado en el micro!
english: Control to ship. Oops, sorry, I sat on the mic! | Oops. Sorry. I sat on the microphone. | Control to ship. Sorry, my chair hit the mic.

spanish: ¡Bravo! El director ha hecho un bailecito.
english: Bravo! The director did a little dance. | Bravo! The director danced a bit. | Great! The director did a happy dance.

spanish: Recibido. ¿Ha sonado muy serio? Estoy practicando.
english: Copy. Did that sound very serious? I'm practicing. | Copy. Did that sound serious? Practicing. | Copied. Was that serious enough? I'm practicing.

spanish: Hola, nave. Soy el del turno de noche. Me he traído galletas.
english: Hello, ship. I'm the night shift. I brought cookies. | Hi, ship. Night shift here. Cookies came with me. | Night shift reporting. With cookies.

spanish: ¡Cambio de turno! Os paso con alguien más simpático.
english: Shift change! I'm handing you to someone nicer. | Shift change! You get someone nicer now. | New shift. Someone nicer is taking over.

spanish: Atención. Ha entrado una mosca en la sala. Seguimos informando.
english: Attention. A fly got into the room. We'll keep you posted. | Alert. There's a fly in the room. Updates soon. | A fly got into control. Stand by.

spanish: ¡Nos hemos ganado una pizza! Gracias a vosotros.
english: We earned a pizza! Thanks to you. | We won a pizza! Thanks to you. | Pizza for us! Because of you.

spanish: Uy, he leído la hoja al revés. Todo bien. Mejor que bien.
english: Oops, I read the sheet upside down. All good. Better than good. | Oops, sheet was upside down. All good. Very good. | Sorry, reading upside down. All great.
Control, you sound happy today. | Control, you sound cheerful. | Control, happy today?

spanish: ¡Hay tarta! Y vosotros vais genial. Pero sobre todo, hay tarta.
english: There's cake! And you're doing great. But mostly, there's cake. | Cake! And you're great. Mostly cake. | We have cake. You're great too. But cake.

spanish: Control, ¿quién está en la radio hoy?
english: Control, who's on the radio today? | Control, who's on the radio? | Control, who's talking today?

spanish: Yo. El de las gafas. El guapo.
english: Me. The one with glasses. The handsome one. | Me. Glasses. The handsome one. | It's me. The handsome one with glasses.
We don't know who that is. | No idea who that is. | We don't know that person.
Control, are you okay? We hear shouting. | Control, all okay? We hear yelling. | Control, why the shouting?

spanish: ¡Gritos de alegría! Ha ganado nuestro equipo.
english: Shouts of joy! Our team won. | Happy shouting! We won. | Joy! Our team won.
What team? | Which team? | What team?

spanish: El de la oficina. A los dardos.
english: The office team. At darts. | Office darts. | The office darts team.
Control, I can hear you eating. | Control, you're eating. I hear it. | Control, I can hear you munching.
That's not true. | Not true. | We're not eating.
I can hear you chewing. | I hear chewing. | Chewing. I hear it.
It's a very small cookie. | It's a tiny cookie. | Very small cookie.
Ship! Ship! We have news. | Ship! We have news! | Ship, big news!
What is it? | What? | What news?

spanish: El becario ha aprendido a hacer café.
english: The intern learned to make coffee. | The intern can make coffee now. | The intern made coffee. Real coffee.
Finally! | At last! | Finally!

spanish: Una pregunta muy científica: ¿qué tal se está ahí?
english: A very scientific question: how is it up there? | Scientific question: how's it up there? | Very scientific question: how are you?
Very good. A bit lonely. | Great. A bit lonely. | Good. Little lonely.

spanish: Os mandamos más radio. Más charla.
english: Then we'll send more radio. More chatting. | More radio, then. More chat. | We'll call more often.

spanish: Aquí Control. Perdón por el silencio. Estábamos discutiendo.
english: Control here. Sorry for the silence. We were arguing. | Sorry for the silence. We were arguing. | Control here. We were busy arguing.
About what? | About? | What about?

spanish: Sobre quién os hablaba primero. He ganado yo.
english: About who talks to you first. I won. | Who talks to you first. I won. | Who gets to call you. I won.

spanish: Control, ¿por qué hay otra voz en la radio?
english: Control, why is there another voice on the radio? | Control, there's another voice on the radio. | Control, who's the new voice?
That's my colleague. Say hi. | My colleague. Say hello. | That's a colleague. Say hi.
Hello, colleague. | Hi, colleague. | Hello there.

spanish: Dice que sois sus favoritos. Yo no lo dije.
english: He says you're his favorites. I didn't say that. | He says you're his favorites. Not me. | He thinks you're the best. His words.

spanish: Control, nos habéis llamado tres veces sin decir nada.
english: Control, you called us three times without saying anything. | Control, you called three times and said nothing. | Control, three calls, no words.

spanish: Lo siento. Me gusta el sonido del botón.
english: Sorry. I like the sound of the button. | Sorry. The button sounds nice. | I like how the button clicks.
Oh! Oh! You're on the big screen! We can see you! | Oh! You're on the big screen! We see you! | Look! There you are! Big screen!
Hello, screen! | Hi, screen! | Hello, big screen!

spanish: Os informamos de que todo va bien. Muy bien. Increíblemente bien.
english: Letting you know everything is fine. Very fine. Amazingly fine. | Just so you know: all fine. Very fine. Super fine. | Update: things are fine. Amazingly fine.
That worries me. | That's worrying. | Now I'm worried.
Control, are you bored without us? | Control, bored without us? | Control, miss us?

spanish: Muchísimo. Hemos ordenado los lápices por colores.
english: Very much. We sorted the pencils by color. | Very. We sorted the pencils by color. | So bored. Pencils are sorted by color now.

spanish: Nave, os leo un mensaje de los niños del colegio.
english: Ship, I'm reading you a message from the school kids. | Message from the school kids. | The school kids sent a message.
Go ahead. | Go on. | Read it.
They say: is there ice cream in space? | Is there ice cream in space? | They ask: ice cream in space?

spanish: Diles que todavía no. Pero que lo estamos pidiendo.
english: Tell them not yet. But we're asking for it. | Not yet. We're working on it. | Not yet. We're asking.

spanish: ¡Recibido! Uy, perdón, era para otra nave.
english: Copy! Oops, sorry, that was for another ship. | Copy! Oh, sorry, that was for another ship. | Copied! Wait, wrong ship.
There's another ship? | Another ship? | There's another one?

spanish: No. Me he confundido conmigo mismo.
english: No. I confused myself. | No. I got confused. | No. My mistake.

spanish: Control a nave: el jefe pregunta quién ha cambiado su silla.
english: Control to ship: the boss asks who switched his chair. | The boss asks who moved his chair. | Ship, the boss's chair was switched. Was it you?
We're in space. | We're in space. | We're in orbit.

spanish: Eso le hemos dicho. No nos cree.
english: That's what we told him. He doesn't believe us. | We told him. He doesn't buy it. | He doesn't believe us.
Control, can you sound more cheerful? | Control, sound happier? | Control, more cheerful, please.
Sure! Hello! How nice! Nice! | Sure! Hello! Wonderful! Nice! | Of course! Hi! Great! Lovely!
Okay. A bit less. | Okay. Less. | Too much. Tone it down.

spanish: Os pongo con el jefe de vuelo. Bueno, está comiendo. Os pongo conmigo otra vez.
english: Putting you through to the flight director. Well, he's eating. Putting you through to me again. | Connecting you to the director. He's eating. Back to me. | Director on the line. No, he's eating. Me again.

spanish: Pequeño problema aquí abajo: se ha acabado el azúcar. Os mantenemos informados.
english: Small problem down here: the sugar ran out. We'll keep you informed. | Small problem here: no sugar left. Updates to follow. | We ran out of sugar. Stand by.

spanish: ¡Cuidado con...! No, nada. Era una mancha en la pantalla.
english: Watch out for...! No, nothing. It was a smudge on the screen. | Watch out for...! Never mind. Screen smudge. | Look out! No. It was a smudge.

spanish: Aquí Control. Hoy estoy muy contento. Pedid lo que queráis.
english: Control here. I'm very cheerful today. Ask for anything. | Control here. Great mood today. Ask me anything. | I'm in a good mood. Ask anything.
More cookies? | Cookies? | More cookies?
Not that. Something else. | Not that. | Anything but that.
